sentences.text: Bacteroides salyersiae is a commensal species of the human gut microbiota and a human gut symbiont.
It carries Bs164, the founding member of glycoside hydrolase family GH164, which was shown to cleave only beta-mannose linkages.
In mice, oral administration of a B. salyersiae strain isolated from the faeces of a healthy individual was reported to protect against chemically induced colitis.
